newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp CEO sees 5 pct 1997 revenue rise.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp CEO sees 5 pct 1997 revenue rise.

text.p: KeyCorp Chief Executive Officer Robert Gillespie said Thursday he thinks the bank is capable of meeting analysts' expectations for the bank to grow its earnings by at least 12 percent a year for the next two to three years.
KeyCorp, the 14th largest bank in the U.S. in terms of assets, earlier announced plans to reformulate itself as a nationwide financial services company.
But, he told reporters before a speech, revenue pressure is "a little more complex" and the bank is likely to end up with about five percent net revenue growth in 1997.
